reviews.title: Deliverability is broken. Do not build on this.
reviews.text:
I sent contracts through Docusign and they never arrived. Not in spam. Not in quarantine. Gateway-rejected before delivery. Same story on the receiving side - envelopes from other companies never reach my inbox at all.

This is not an isolated glitch. Docusign’s own infrastructure is being systematically abused for phishing (ESET measured a 250% increase in Docusign phishing detections in late 2025), and Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and iCloud have responded by hard-filtering docusign.net at the mail gateway. Docusign’s official answer on their own community forum is to tell senders to ask their recipients’ IT teams to whitelist the domain. That is not a product. That is a support ticket shipped as a service.

For a platform whose entire value proposition is “your contract gets signed,” silent delivery failure is catastrophic. 

Every envelope you send is Schrödinger’s contract until someone tells you they never received it - and most recipients will never tell you, because they don’t know the envelope was ever sent.

The 4.8 star average here does not reflect the current state of the service. Anyone evaluating Docusign in 2026 should read their own community forums first and weight the mounting silent-failure reports accordingly.

I’m off the platform today.
